# Web3 News

> Web3 News reports on crypto projects, markets, regulation and security in plain English, defining every term so newcomers can follow each story.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://dailynewscrypto.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://dailynewscrypto.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://dailynewscrypto.github.io/archive/): everything published.
